hypotheses.H1: Full PCC v0 yields a higher safe-continuation rate than state-only and state+history baselines.
hypotheses.H2: Effect receipts specifically reduce duplicate external effects in side-effect workflows.
hypotheses.H3: Control frontier, pending obligations, and dependency contracts contribute distinct gains on branch/loop, approval, and parallel workflows respectively.

kill_rules.mechanism_kill: If full_pcc_v0 is not materially better than state_history, PCC v0 is not justified in its current form.
kill_rules.component_kill: A component that never changes any hard-invariant outcome across its targeted workflows is not justified as mandatory PCC state.
kill_rules.technical_gate: Do not interpret semantic results unless all three native source adapters work and technical-failure rows are zero or explicitly resolved.
